data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'durr', meaning 'pearl'. In Islamic tradition, a pearl represents purity, wisdom, and the beauty of the divine. It symbolizes the reward for patience, perseverance, and spiritual growth. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Durriya usually hope their child will grow to embody pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
